name: Decline Dumbbell JM Press
description: A decline bench JM press variation using dumbbells instead of a barbell. The decline angle increases tricep activation and allows natural wrist rotation. Each dumbbell moves independently, requiring more stabilization and potentially revealing asymmetries.

execution.starting_position: Set up for Decline Dumbbell JM Press in the appropriate position.
execution.setup_instructions: Prepare equipment and body position for Decline Dumbbell JM Press.
steps: Step 1: Lie on decline bench with dumbbells at arm's length above chest.
Step 2: Lower dumbbells toward throat with elbows flaring to 45 degrees.
Step 3: Lower until forearms are past parallel, feeling tricep stretch.
Step 4: Press dumbbells back overhead in a tricep-dominant path.
execution.breathing_instructions: Exhale during the exertion phase, inhale during the return.
common_mistakes: Lowering dumbbells to chest instead of throat
safety_considerations: Keep joints aligned throughout the movement.
Use controlled weight appropriate for skill level.
execution.range_of_motion_guidance: Move through full range of motion without compromising joint integrity.
coaching_cues: Throat is the target, not the chest
